integrity: Proof supported by stationary-generator calculation, exact hitting-kernel duality and periodic-clock functional CLT; finite verification tests do not certify an infinite limit. Prior homogeneous interval asymptotics and local covariance evaluations are credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite stationary ASIP with independent Poisson injection and strictly positive exponential gate rates; fixed positive periodic gate-rate environment for large-site covariance scaling; no assertion for random rate fields, slow gates, Pearson correlations, full joint law, or non-Markovian transfer.
title: Periodic-rate broadening of long-range anticorrelations in the asymmetric simple inclusion process
